resolutions.title: A non-orbit line can silently swallow an orbit command
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's "An unclosed quote on a non-orbit shell line hides every later orbit line in the fence", walked in log 2026-10-08T23-53-57Z: the tokenizer now escapes a backslash outside quotes as the shell does, so `echo \"` opens no quote, and an open quote fails extraction whatever the first word. Re-checked by injection: `echo \"` then `orbit status --frobnicate` in a reference fence fails the sweep on the orbit line's unknown option.
resolutions.evidence: resolved in address-reviews-2026-10-08T23-53-57Z; test/core/cli-grammar/injections.test.ts "an escaped quote opens none, so the orbit line after it is parsed and fails" passes, and fails against the HEAD helper

resolutions.title: SKILL.md diagnostic locations omit the generated frontmatter
resolutions.action: Each SKILL.md surface is now the generator's own output, generateSkillContent(template, version) — frontmatter above the instructions, as written for Claude and Codex (no command-reference transform) — so a reported line is a line of the installed file. The frontmatter carried one orbit snippet (address-reviews compatibility line, `orbit status --change <name> --json`), now parsed: 130 snippets, 35 bare names, 0 failures, 0 guard hits. Design D3 and the sweep floor comment say so.
